exclusions.reason: The created Account response returns auth_token.
The one-time API-key response returns secret.
The one-time signing-key response returns secret.
The request creates and transmits a SIP Password.
The ephemeral network-token response returns credential and password values.
The response returns the live one-time validation_code used to prove caller-ID control.
The Account response returns auth_token; this removes the unsafe legacy account.read operation.
The schema documents only a 307 JSON redirect response; connection.api refuses cross-origin redirects and classifies an unfollowed 3xx as an error, so this route is not truthfully executable.
The Account collection embeds auth_token for every returned account.
The updated Account response returns auth_token.
The request rotates and transmits a SIP Password.

safety.connection: Every request uses the enrolled Twilio Basic connection at the fixed https://api.twilio.com origin.
safety.credentials: Account responses, one-time key secrets, ephemeral network credentials, SIP password writes, and the live caller-ID validation code are excluded.
safety.request_subsets: CreateCall and CreateParticipant omit SIP credentials and CallToken. CreatePayments omits the optional untyped processor Parameter object.
safety.requests: Every admitted POST uses the documented application/x-www-form-urlencoded body with closed typed body fields.
safety.responses: Every admitted JSON response opts into lossless unsafe-integer parsing.
safety.pagination: Automatic next-path pagination is declared only when the documented response contains one mergeable array and next_page_uri.
safety.cache: New reads are uncached. Compatibility reads retain their prior cache and approval contracts.
safety.source: No work-entity Source is declared because this API family exposes communications and administrative resources, not a task, note, or project model.
